title: Update dependencies with known vulnerabilities and switch on alerts for new ones
summary: JavaScript and Rust dependencies with published fixes were updated (shipped npm findings 29 to 0, Rust 31 to 6) and a Dependabot file was added; switching on alerts in the repository settings is still the maintainer's step.
lessons_learned: An exact-version npm override on a shared library (prosemirror-view) can install nested copies instead of one top-level copy, which breaks instanceof checks across editor plugins; pin it as a direct dependency and override with "$name"
